items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队决定在墨西哥大奖赛期间用预备车手里奥·伊拉卡瓦替换埃斯特班·奥康。

items.originalTitle: Haas drops Esteban Ocon for F1 Mexico GP
detailZh: 哈斯车队在墨西哥大奖赛期间放弃了埃斯特班·奥康
这位法国人将被哈斯车队的预备车手里约·伊拉卡瓦取代，以完成墨西哥周末的比赛
哈斯一级方程式车队做出了令人震惊的决定，用预备车手里约·伊拉卡瓦取代埃斯特班·奥康，以完成墨西哥大奖赛周末的比赛
伊拉卡瓦将作为奥利弗·贝尔曼的队友参加最终练习、排位赛和周日的比赛，他在周五早上也作为新秀任务的一部分，驾驶了奥康的VF-26赛车参加FP1练习赛。
奥康回归进行第二次练习，最终排名第13，但他在与赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒就是否坚持使用软胎还是切换到中性胎发生争执后引起了骚动。
哈斯车队发表声明称：“里约·平川将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余比赛中取代埃斯蒂班·奥康。”
“里约在周五的阿图罗·罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了FP1练习，这是他本赛季的第三次自由练习，驾驶VF-26赛车，最终排名第15。”"
“这位日本车手将在周六和周日的71圈大奖赛的最后练习和排位赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这标志着里约的F1赛车首秀。”
“目前将不再发表任何声明。”
Hirakawa的F1首秀将在32岁时到来。他在日本度过大部分职业生涯，成为2017年超级GT冠军，之后转战世界耐力锦标赛。
他与丰田车队一起赢得了两个WEC冠军，并在勒芒24小时耐力赛中获胜，这种与日本品牌的合作关系使他得以在2025年成为哈斯车队的储备车手。
这是由于丰田和哈斯形成技术合作伙伴关系的结果，导致他参加了七次FP1各节练习与排位，并成为2027年F1赛车的争夺者——但最终输给了Rafael Camara。
对于奥康来说——他将被卡玛拉取代——这标志着他与2024年阿尔卑斯车队任期结束时的惊人相似，当时他被继任者杰克·多伊恩取代参加阿布扎比决赛。
据Motorsport.com了解，这位30岁的法国人在2025年加入哈斯车队后表现不佳，很可能会在2027年成为阿斯顿·马丁的预备车手，因为在哈斯车队的表现不如比阿曼。
detailEn: Haas drops Esteban Ocon for F1 Mexico GP
The Frenchman will be replaced by Haas reserve Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the Mexican weekend
The Haas Formula 1 team has made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the Mexico Grand Prix weekend.
Hirakawa will act as Oliver Bearman’s team-mate for final practice, qualifying and Sunday’s race, having also taken Ocon’s VF-26 on Friday morning as part of the rookie mandate for FP1 sessions.
Ocon returned for second practice, finishing 13th, but caused a stir following his spat with race engineer Laura Mueller over whether to stick to the soft tyres or switch to medium rubber.
A Haas statement read: “Ryo Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix.
“Ryo participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday, his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
“The Japanese driver will partner team-mate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday’s 71-lap grand prix – marking Ryo's Formula 1 race debut.
“No further statements will be made at this time.”
Hirakawa’s F1 debut will come at the age of 32. He spent much of his career in Japan, becoming the 2017 Super GT champion, before moving to the World Endurance Championship.
He has claimed two WEC titles with Toyota, alongside victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours, and that relationship with the Japanese marque earned him a move to Haas as its reserve driver in 2025.
That came as the result of Toyota and Haas forming a technical partnership, leading to him contesting seven FP1 sessions and being a contender for a 2027 F1 seat - only to lose out to Rafael Camara.
For Ocon – who is set to be replaced by Camara – it marks a striking resemblance to how his Alpine stint ended in 2024, as he was replaced by successor Jack Doohan for the Abu Dhabi finale.
The 30-year-old Frenchman is likely to become Aston Martin’s reserve in 2027, Motorsport.com understands, after a disappointing time since joining Haas in 2025 – comfortably being beaten by Bearman.

detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康：哈斯在墨西哥城大奖赛周末剩余赛程中由平川亮接替这位法国车手，未提供原因
埃斯特班·奥康将不再参加墨西哥城大奖赛余下环节，哈斯由平川亮接替这位法国车手；哈斯未说明换下奥康的原因；奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队
埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."

items.titleZh: 2026年F1车队如何应对墨西哥城赛道的高海拔挑战
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥城赛道因其海拔高度而成为F1赛季的特例，车手面临更大挑战，而赛车则因空气密度降低而拥有更高的速度。

media.altZh: 2026年F1车队如何应对墨西哥城赛道的高海拔挑战 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: How F1 teams are tackling Mexico's altitude challenge in 2026
detailZh: 墨西哥城赛道是F1赛季的特例，主要因为其海拔高度：海拔2240米，相当于空气密度降低约25%，这使得一切事情都变得更加困难。
对于车手来说，这基本上意味着更艰苦的工作，但对于赛车来说，情况则完全不同，因为在那个海拔高度，赛车产生的下压力和阻力都会减少。在过去，车队会使用更多或更少的摩纳哥规格的翼片，但本赛季随着翼片规则和主动空气动力学的变化，他们没有这样的可能性。
因此，基本上赛车会滑动得更厉害，但减小的阻力意味着最高速度甚至比正常情况下还要快。这意味着你会在那些长直道上更快地到达终点，需要更长的制动距离，这会在刹车中产生更多的热量。
这些赛车是涡轮增压的，所以实际上，尽管涡轮需要更努力地工作，并且在整个圈的大部分时间里都会以尽可能接近最大转速运行，但它仍然会产生相似水平的动力输出。这意味着发动机的热量排放并没有减少，因此你需要比平时多冷却大约25%。
此外，由于这是一个富含电能的赛道布局，你还会因为收集和部署而使电池组和其控制系统产生更多的热量。
基本上，一切都需要更高的冷却水平。以下是我查看顶级四支车队从他们通常运行的配置中做出的改变。由于进气区域是车身侧面撞击结构的一部分，因此改变它基本上需要重新进行侧面撞击测试，所以大家都会关注冷却出口的大小、位置和数量。
首先，我们可以看看后出口。
红色椭圆突出显示了朝后的出口。麦克拉伦提高了排气出口上方的部分，以增加出口面积。
它已经在奥斯汀使用了一个规格二的出口，正如红色椭圆所示，梅赛德斯在墨西哥保留了这一点。现在它更像是一个三角形开口，这是通过提升上部发动机罩表面实现的，尤其是在中央部分，位于排气出口上方。
法拉利选择了简单地扩大两侧的出口，如两个绿色椭圆所示。中央部分的高度与上一版本相似。
从我看到的来看，红牛并没有真正费心改变这个区域的出口。
后出口的位置大致相同，实际上，所有车队的大小也大致相同 - 因此，它们对整体汽车效率的影响将很容易理解。
当你从这个区域获得最大效益时，就要转向侧箱和发动机盖百叶窗出口。就最大化冷却效果而言，这是最关键的区域，这个区域的大幅变化可能会影响汽车其他部分的空气流动结构。这不仅仅是关于更大的百叶窗，更重要的是百叶窗相对于车身表面的压力位置以及百叶窗的放置方式和位置可以产生重大影响。
在这场比较中排名前两位的赛车，梅赛德斯和法拉利，在放置上相当相似，两者都有两个相当明确的定位。这些位置通常放置在内部散热器流量最弱的地方。
另一方面，麦克拉伦的放置更具美学吸引力，而且所有部分都连接在一起，这也增加了美学效果。我的观点是，只要它能达到目标，为什么选择丑陋的，而不是对眼睛有视觉吸引力的呢？
另一方面，红牛在外观上看起来对墨西哥高原的适应改动最少。也许在其他比赛中它被过度冷却了，但我对此表示怀疑——因为大多数车队都会为每个单独的赛道推极限。
这就是发动机及其辅助冷却需求的变化。另一个大的冷却需求是刹车，很难看出谁在那里做得最好。
对于车队来说，很难模拟那些车辆最重时的早期比赛圈数，当你在交通中行驶时；当刹车过热时，唯一的方法是减少使用它们——这意味着更多的提升和滑行。
那么，谁在这所有方面都做得最好，同时最小化了空气动力学损失？我认为我们可能要到周日晚上才知道。
detailEn: The Mexico City track is one of the outliers of the Formula 1 season, mainly because of the altitude: it is 2240 meters above sea level, which equates to roughly 25% less dense air, so it makes everything just that bit more difficult.

For the drivers it's basically harder work, but for the cars it's a very different story, because at that altitude the cars will produce less downforce and with that less drag. In the past, teams would use more or less Monaco-specification wings but this season with the change in wing regulations and active aero they don't have that possibility.

So, basically the ars will slide around more but the reduced drag means that top speeds are even faster than normal. This means that you will arrive at the end of those long straights faster and require a longer braking duration, which generates more heat in the brakes.

These cars are turbocharged so in reality even though the turbo has to work harder and will be running at or as near to its maximum rpm as possible for most of the lap, it will still produce similar levels of power output. This means the engine's heat rejection isn't reduced, so you need to cool the cars roughly 25% more than you normally have to.
Also, as it's an electrical energy-rich circuit layout you will also generate more heat into the battery pack and its control systems simply from harvesting and deployment.

Basically, everything needs higher levels of cooling and below I have had a look at the top-four teams' changes from what they normally run. It's not easy to alter the inlet area on these cars as it is part of the side impact structure, so changing it would basically require redoing the side impact tests, so instead everyone will focus on the cooling exits, size, location and quantity.
First of all we can have a look at the rear exits.
The red ellipse highlights the rearwards-facing outlet. McLaren has raised the section above the exhaust outlet to increase the exit area.

It already ran a spec-two outlet at Austin and as can be seen by the red ellipse Mercedes has retained that for Mexico. Now it is more of a triangular opening, which it has achieved by lifting the upper engine cover surface, especially in the central section, above the exhaust outlet.
Ferrari has gone for simply a bigger exit at the sides, as highlighted by the two green ellipses. The central section is similar in height to the previous version.
From what I can see, Red Bull hasn't really bothered to alter the outlet in this area.

The rear exits are in more or less the same position and, in reality, are more or less the same size for all the teams - so the effect they have on the overall cars efficiency will be well understood.

When you are getting the maximum from that area then it's onto the sidepod and engine-cover louvre outlets. This is the most critical area as far as maximising the cooling is concerned, and major changes in this area can affect the airflow structure of the rest of the car coming along behind. It's not just about bigger louvres, it's more about placement relative to the body-surface pressure and how and where those louvres are placed can have a major influence.

The top two cars in this comparison, Mercedes and Ferrari, are fairly similar in placement and both have two fairly well-defined locations. These positions are normally placed where the internal radiator flow is at its weakest.

The McLaren on the other hand has a more aesthetically pleasing placing and the fact that it all connects together also adds to the aesthetics. My sentiments are that as long as it achieves the objective, why go for ugly when it can be visually appealing to the eye?

Red Bull on the other hand externally looks like it has made the fewest changes to compensate for the altitude in Mexico. Perhaps it was overcooled at other races but I would doubt this - as most teams will push the limits for each individual track.
That's all the engine and its ancillary cooling requirement changes compared. The other big cooling requirement is for the brakes and it's difficult to see who has done the best job there.

For the teams, it's difficult to simulate those early race laps when the car is at its heaviest and you are running in traffic; when the brakes overheat, the only way to cool them down is to use them less - which means more lifting and coasting.
So, who has done the best job on all of this while minimising the aerodynamic losses? I think it's going to be Sunday night before we know that.
keyPointsZh: 墨西哥城赛道海拔高，空气密度降低，对车手和赛车都有影响。
赛车在高海拔产生的下压力和阻力减少，导致速度更快。
赛车需要更高的冷却水平，以应对涡轮增压带来的热量增加。
keyPointsEn: The Mexico City track's high altitude affects both drivers and cars, reducing air density and increasing car speed.
Reduced downforce and drag at high altitude lead to higher speeds for the cars.
Higher levels of cooling are required for the cars due to the increased heat from turbochargers.

items.originalTitle: Ferrari downplays expectations for F1 Mexico GP despite blistering Friday
detailZh: 法拉利对墨西哥大奖赛抱有期望，尽管周五表现惊艳
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在墨西哥周五的FP1和FP2中都排名第一
尽管查尔斯·勒克莱尔在周五的两次练习中都排名第一，但法拉利一级方程式负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔对墨西哥大奖赛的期望进行了淡化。
勒克莱尔在FP1中设定了1分18.128秒的节奏，然后在Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez的FP2中将这一基准降至1分17.827秒。
队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿也表现出色，在首节练习赛中排名第四，落后勒克莱尔0.738秒，直到FP2中途引擎故障之前一直位于前五名。
瓦瑟尔在周五表示：“我并不需要自信或不确定。我们必须努力工作，我们必须尽力为明天做好准备。
“条件非常极端，[比我们之前知道的]还要高海拔。这对我们来说是一个挑战，对其他人也是如此。这意味着我们今晚有很多工作要做。
“路面非常颠簸，可能在1号弯之前有点过于颠簸。这几乎很危险。我们今晚必须做些什么。
“总的来说，我认为这是周末的一个不错的开始，但还有很长的路要走。”
法国人的评论是在上周的比赛中提出的，当时法拉利在奥斯汀的每一节练习中都排名第一，但最终只获得了第四和第五的名次，最后分别获得了第二和第四名。
勒克莱尔表示，法拉利在赛道演变上遇到了困难，而汉密尔顿将Q3的困境归咎于他的轮胎，因此瓦瑟尔对本周的情况持谨慎态度。
墨西哥的低抓地力赛道以其赛道演变而闻名，加上领跑的梅赛德斯车队以及复苏的红牛车队的状态良好，对于法拉利来说，杆位并非唾手可得。
“每个人都会进步，每个人都会根据海拔高度调整套件，”瓦瑟尔补充道。
“确实，与我们要面对的相比，这完全是一种极端。而且对于车手来说，在墨西哥带来这种级别的下压力，这是一个挑战。
“他们习惯了拥有本赛季最大的翼片。我认为与去年相比，蒙扎的差距比摩纳哥或墨西哥要小得多，这对他们来说是一个更大的挑战。”
但这也被视为意大利品牌在巴塞罗那的汉密尔顿和银石站的勒克莱尔之后，争取2026赛季第三个胜利的绝佳机会。
这是因为墨西哥城海拔较高，这意味着涡轮必须更加努力地工作，但由于SF-26的涡轮比其他涡轮小，延迟应该是最小的。
正因为如此，例如梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔将法拉利称为周末前的热门选择，但汉密尔顿在FP2之后驳回了这一说法。
“我并不完全同意关于涡轮的事情，”这位七次世界冠军说。 “如果你看看梅赛德斯和红牛的速度，他们在直道结束时的速度仍然非常快，就像每一场比赛一样。
“涡轮并没有带来差异。它在直道结束时仍然拉得更多。
“我认为我们仍然失去了两到三个十分之一。但是赛车表现良好。我们的赛车工作得相当不错。”
detailEn: Ferrari downplays expectations for F1 Mexico GP despite blistering Friday
Charles Leclerc topped both FP1 and FP2 on Friday in Mexico
Ferrari Formula 1 boss Fred Vasseur has downplayed expectations for the Mexico Grand Prix despite Charles Leclerc topping both Friday practice sessions.
The Ferrari driver set the pace with a 1m18.128s in FP1, before lowering that benchmark to 1m17.827s for FP2 at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
Team-mate Lewis Hamilton was also competitive, having taken fourth in opening practice, 0.738s behind Leclerc, before sitting inside the top five until his engine failed midway through FP2.
Vasseur said on Friday: “I don't have to be confident or not. We have to work, we have to try to get the best for tomorrow.
“Conditions are mega extreme, [more than] we knew before with the altitude. It's a challenge for us, but also for the others. It means that we have a lot of work to do tonight.
“It's mega bumpy, probably a bit too much before Turn 1. It's almost dangerous. We'll have to do something tonight.
“Overall I think that it was a good start of the weekend, but there's still a long way to go.”
The Frenchman’s comments came with last week in mind, as Ferrari topped each practice session in Austin, only to qualify fourth and fifth before finishing second and fourth.
Leclerc claimed Ferrari struggled with the track evolution, whereas Hamilton put the Q3 woes down to his tyres, and so Vasseur is wary of a similar situation occurring this weekend.
The low-grip Mexico circuit is notorious for its track evolution, and with runaway leader Mercedes – plus the resurgent Red Bull – in form, pole is not a given for Ferrari.
“Everybody will improve, everybody will fine-tune the package with the altitude,” added Vasseur.
“It's true that it's completely extreme compared to what we have to face and the fact that for the drivers to come with this level of downforce in Mexico, it's a challenge.
“They were used to having the biggest wing of the season. I think the delta compared to last year is much smaller in Monza than in Monaco or Mexico, and it's even more of a challenge for them.”
But this is still seen as a great opportunity for the Italian marque to claim its third victory of the 2026 season, following Hamilton in Barcelona and Leclerc at Silverstone.
That is because Mexico City is high in altitude, which means the turbo must work harder, yet because the SF-26’s turbo is smaller than others, lag should be at a minimum.
It is for that reason that Mercedes man George Russell, for example, labelled Ferrari as the pre-weekend favourite, but Hamilton rebuffed that claim following FP2.

“I don't really agree on the turbo thing,” said the seven-time world champion. “If you look at the speeds to the Mercedes and the Red Bull, they're still massively quicker at the end of the straights, like they are every race.
“The turbo is not making a difference. It's still pulling a lot more at the end of straights.
“I think we're still losing a good two or three tenths. But the car is behaving well. Our car works pretty well.”
